chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has already fulfilled it in the obligatory prayer or in a voluntary prayer.
ai.seo_question: Can one prayer count as both obligatory and voluntary?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this ruling to clarify the distinct legal categories of fard (obligatory) and nafl (voluntary) prayers, emphasizing that their spiritual merits and ritual requirements are not interchangeable. This distinction underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that specific acts of worship require specific intentions (niyyah) and cannot be merged to fulfill dual obligations, ensuring the completeness of both the duty and the supererogatory act.
